title: OS-Wizard: Scaling Computer-Using Agents to Specialized Software via Knowledge-Guided Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2610.33907v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computer-using agents are increasingly capable of performing complex tasks in the digital world. However, high-quality interaction trajectories remain scarce for specialized desktop applications, where limited application knowledge, cumbersome GUI workflows, and incomplete exploration hinder automated collection. We introduce OS-Wizard, an automated trajectory collection framework. It combines tutorial-guided exploration with a hybrid GUI--Code action space, providing application-specific knowledge and simplifying GUI workflows through direct execution of application-native commands. The framework also checkpoints and revisits pivotal states during tree exploration to explore alternative workflows, complementing linear rollouts for broader coverage. We collect 10.9K trajectories comprising 54.9K state--action samples. Fine-tuning open-source base models on this corpus yields a best-performing model that improves performance on a benchmar

translated_title: OS-Wizard：通过知识引导的探索将计算机使用智能体扩展至专业软件
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体在数字世界中执行复杂任务的能力日益增强。然而，对于专业桌面应用程序而言，高质量的交互轨迹仍然稀缺，因为应用程序知识有限、GUI工作流程繁琐以及探索不完整等因素阻碍了自动化数据收集。我们提出了OS-Wizard，一个自动化轨迹收集框架。该框架将教程引导的探索与混合GUI-代码动作空间相结合，提供应用程序特定的知识，并通过直接执行应用程序原生命令来简化GUI工作流程。此外，该框架还在树状探索过程中对关键状态进行检查点记录与重访，以探索替代性工作流程，从而补充线性推演，实现更广泛的覆盖。我们收集了10.9K条轨迹，包含54.9K个状态-动作样本。在该语料库上微调开源基础模型后，得到的性能最佳的模型在基准测试中提升了表现。
tldr: OS-Wizard是一个自动化轨迹收集框架，通过教程引导探索与混合GUI-代码动作空间为专业桌面软件收集了10.9K条高质量交互轨迹，基于此微调的开源模型显著提升了计算机使用智能体的性能。
en_tdlr: OS-Wizard is an automated trajectory collection framework that combines tutorial-guided exploration with a hybrid GUI-Code action space to gather 10.9K high-quality trajectories for specialized desktop software, and fine-tuning open-source models on this corpus significantly improves computer-using agent performance.
